name: Memail Focus Inbox
author: Saivra
description: Configurable read-only Focus views, with optional sign-in account scoping.

enabled.label: Show focus tabs
enabled.description: Adds views to Inbox folders. Mail is never moved or relabeled.

showNewsletters.label: Show Newsletters view
showNewsletters.description: Matches messages with a List-Unsubscribe header. Starred newsletters also appear in Focus.

showUnreadBadges.label: Show unread counts
showUnreadBadges.description: Counts unread messages in each view, not total messages.

focusMode.label: Focus includes
focusMode.description: Starred mail remains in Focus after reading. Newsletters are detected by List-Unsubscribe.

accountNames.label: Apply to accounts
accountNames.description: Optional comma-separated sign-in names, for example alice@example.com, work-alice. Leave empty for every signed-in account.

en.error.otherTabs: Another inbox category plugin is active. Memail focus tabs are paused; disable the other category plugin before showing them.
en.error.accountScope: Enter up to 20 sign-in names separated by commas. Use literal usernames or email addresses; wildcards and display names are not supported.
en.error.focusMode: Choose a supported Focus option in the plugin settings.
